proposals.name: DayOne Kiveriö Unnamed Data Center Campus
decisive_chain: SRV job 2984 August 11 bulletin reports construction at Ilmarisentie 3 with frame work roughly halfway; explicit day wins over inconsistent week 32 label, which remains disclosed.
Same job's main page explicitly names DayOne and Ilmarisentie 3 in Kiveriö. Undated page, old April release, June construction context and 2027 forecast supply no extra selected work dates.

City data-center permit 398-2025-418 names parcel 398-5-966-7 at Väinämöisentie 2a. City's October permit register page 5 puts the same permit and parcel at Ilmarisentie 3, closing the two-frontage address bridge.
City's historical DayOne announcement identifies one Kiveriö site between Ilmarisentie and Väinämöisentie. DC-A and associated buildings or future phases are not separate campuses.

NLS official cadastral WFS exact nationalCadastralReference query returns one labelled parcel and its provider referencePoint in EPSG:3067. Primary service page and policy explicitly bind this dataset to CC BY 4.0.

Provider point transforms through pyproj 3.8.0 to [25.703874164769484,60.990755708567505] WGS84. It is inside the valid 153-vertex parcel ring. Point and full parcel intersect none of 159 selected features; positional accuracy remains unknown.
retained_caveats: Publication metadata uses midnight UTC only as a date-only normalization, not an observed time or timezone.
Visible Viikko 32 is inconsistent with the August 11 calendar day. Earlier July/May/June labels are not promoted to additional dates.
No transformation-operation accuracy, decimal count or cadastral metadata is treated as measured point accuracy.
Official cadastral reference point is a campus locator, not a recomputed centroid, building outline, full campus boundary, entrance or work extent.
Old road, Dahl wholesaler, unit 3a and service-area coordinates remain excluded. New exact official parcel route resolves the old locator hold without editing it.
September cadastral response and 2018 lifespan metadata are not physical-work observations.
Bounded successor review found no whole-campus completion, operation or cancellation through cutoff; absence is not proven.
